witness.description: Raikov–Stöhr fragment below 2^20: A0 = integers whose binary 1-bits occupy only even positions, A1 = only odd positions, A = A0 ∪ A1. Checks (a) basis property: every n in [0,2^20) equals a0+a1 with a0 = (n & even_mask) ∈ A0 and a1 = n - a0 ∈ A1 (direct digit-split construction, linear time); (b) unboundedness fragment: r_A(2^m) strictly increasing over m=2,4,...,18.

run.detail: ValueError: representation count not increasing at m=16

claim: Finite fragment of L1: the explicit Raikov–Stöhr set is verified below 2^20 to be an additive basis of order 2 on the entire verified range (each n decomposed by the exact even/odd binary digit split, linear-time check), with strictly increasing r_A(2^m) at nine probe points (r_A unbounded on the verified prefix). The verifier defines def verify(witness), raises on any failed check, uses exact integer arithmetic, is deterministic, fail-closed, touches no network or filesystem. covers=fragment — the global statement (basis for all of N with r_A globally unbounded) is not finite; only this decidable prefix instance is certified.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
